<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include">
    <sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <access>public</access>
        <active>true</active>
        <api_name>sn_invst_pln.InvstDeductFundFromInv</api_name>
        <caller_access/>
        <client_callable>false</client_callable>
        <description>Implements extension point sn_invst_pln.InvstDeductFundFromInv</description>
        <mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
        <name>InvstDeductFundFromInv</name>
        <sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
        <script><![CDATA[var InvstDeductFundFromInv = Class.create();
InvstDeductFundFromInv.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    process: function( /*single entry*/ current, previous) {
        // return modified current record
        this.deduct(current);
    },

    deduct: function(record) {
        InvestmentPlanningLogger.log("deduct -> " + record.getDisplayValue());
        if (gs.nil(record.getValue("parent"))) {
            // Top most investment
            return true;
        }
        var parentGr = new GlideRecordSecure(InvstPlanningConstants.FUNDING_BASE_FUND_TBL);
        if (parentGr.get(record.getValue("parent"))) {
            var parentAvailableCapex = parseFloat(parentGr.available_amount_capex.amount);
            var recordFundedCapex = parseFloat(record.funded_amount_capex.amount);
            var parentUpdatedAvailableCapex = parentAvailableCapex - recordFundedCapex;
            parentGr.available_amount_capex.amount = parentUpdatedAvailableCapex;

            var parentAvailableOpex = parseFloat(parentGr.available_amount_opex.amount);
            var recordFundedOpex = parseFloat(record.funded_amount_opex.amount);
            var parentUpdatedAvailableOpex = parentAvailableOpex - recordFundedOpex;
            parentGr.available_amount_opex.amount = parentUpdatedAvailableOpex;
            parentGr.update();
        }
    },

    type: 'InvstDeductFundFromInv'
};]]></script>
